- **`${model:+--model "$model"}` under `set -u`** is safe (the variable is always assigned, possibly
  empty). Do not quote the whole expansion — `"${model:+--model "$model"}"` would pass one argument.
- **`launch-preflight` stays exactly where it was in the sequence**: after `export BEADS_ACTOR`,
  before `exec` — the consumer-sync test asserts the links exist when the stub is reached, and the
  submodule-behind test asserts they do not exist when it refuses.
- **The elisp reader's path is `.claude/cerebro/scripts/roster` relative to `repo-root`** (through
  `cerebro--script`), so `fleet-reads-the-roster-script` must build a directory with
  `.claude/cerebro` symlinked to the repository root — a bare `(cerebro--fleet repo-root)` against
  the cerebro checkout finds nothing. Clean the temp dir in `unwind-protect`.
- **`buffer-lists-every-agent-once` must stub `cerebro--fleet`**, not `cerebro--roster` — with the
  old stub, `cerebro--interactive-agents` would shell out to `/fake/repo/.claude/cerebro/scripts/roster`
  and error.
- **Byte-compile in CI is warning-checked**: `mapconcat`'s third argument, `seq-filter` (needs
  `seq`, already required), and `make-symbolic-link` in the test are all fine on 28.2; do not use
  `string-search` (28.1+, fine) or `take` (29+).
- **Emacs backup files (`*.el~`, `*.sh~`) are committed alongside originals in cerebro** — do not
  edit them, do not delete them.
- **cerebro's CI may not trigger on a brand-new branch's first push** (retrospective ah-6uo): check
  `gh pr view <n> --json statusCheckRollup` early; `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <branch>` if empty
  after two minutes.
- **`agents/orchestrator.md` is long and Cerebro reads it live**; keep the edits to the four spots
  named and do not reflow neighbouring paragraphs.
- Interactive names appear in **`--name` process scans** (`cerebro--name-in-args-p`) — `launch`
  must keep passing `--name "$name"` exactly, or a hand-started session stops showing `up`.
